mentions.name: ScreenSpy
mentions.description: This app lets parents observe what their child is doing on a desktop PC, helping them tell whether the child is playing games like Roblox or doing homework. Part of a suite of mobile apps for parents.
mentions.problem: Parents cannot easily see what their child is doing on the desktop PC, e.g. whether it is Roblox or homework.
mentions.source_excerpt: * https://screenspy.app - observe what youd child is doing on desktop PC. Roblox or homework?

mentions.name: ScreenSpy
mentions.description: This app monitors children's computer activity so parents can see what their kids are doing, such as whether they're doing homework or watching YouTube shorts; it is being developed into a product.
mentions.problem: Parents lack visibility into what their kids are doing on the computer, such as whether they're doing homework or watching YouTube shorts.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to know what my kids were doing on the computer: homework or watching youtube shorts, so I built https://screenspy.app to monitor them. Now I’m working on turning it into a product.

evidence.value: I wanted to know what my kids were doing on the computer: homework or watching youtube shorts, so I built https://screenspy.app to monitor them. Now I’m working on turning it into a product.
